summary: All four requirements are substantially implemented. REQ-1 (3D coins via React Three Fiber) is addressed by the new FloatingQMYCoins.tsx with at least 5 coins, gold metallic material, QMY text, and float/drift animations. REQ-2 (luxury aesthetic) is addressed by luxury CSS classes in index.css and the redesigned HomePage.tsx. REQ-3 (scroll-to-title on load) is implemented via useEffect/scrollIntoView in HomePage.tsx. REQ-4 (remove Caffeine references) is reflected in the file-summaries noting no Caffeine references in index.html and footers. One minor concern: Footer.tsx is not shown directly in the diff, so Caffeine removal there cannot be fully confirmed from the diff alone.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove all references to 'Caffeine' from Footer.tsx, Layout.tsx, and any other frontend files
missing_requirements.reason: Footer.tsx and Layout.tsx are not shown as modified files in the diff. There is no direct evidence of those files being changed to remove Caffeine references, only an indirect note in the file summaries.
